say:2:1560310001:1.text: Phew... these materials should be more than enough! Now we just need to figure out what to make, and get Zanie's help with the rest.
say:2:1560310001:1.source_cn: 呼……这些材料应该足够了！接下来，只要确定要做什么玩具...

say:4:1560310002:1.text: Bright and warm... I've got it!
say:4:1560310002:1.source_cn: 亮亮的、温暖的东西……我想到了！

say:5:1560310003:0.text: Remember that lantern Indris gave us? We could make Daimon a hawk moth-shaped lantern!
say:5:1560310003:0.source_cn: 还记得因度厄送给我们的夜灯吗？我们可以为戴蒙制作一盏鹰...

say:7:1560310004:1.text: You're right, a lantern is exactly what he'd love. We've got the materials. Now we just need the wick.
say:7:1560310004:1.source_cn: 你说得对，灯的确很符合戴蒙的要求。材料都找到了，现在只...

say:8:1560310005:1.text: Then let's grab one from the store!

say:9:1560310006:1.text: Hmm... if it's for Daimon, we can't use a regular wick. We'll need one that stays lit even in freezing weather.
say:9:1560310006:1.source_cn: 唔……要送给戴蒙的话，恐怕不能用普通的燃芯。需要那种即...

say:10:1560310007:1.text: I've got a bottle of special lamp oil. Not sure if it'll work, but it's worth a shot.
say:10:1560310007:1.source_cn: 我有一瓶特殊的灯油，不知道能不能派上用场。

say:11:1560310008:1.text: They say it's made from rare alchemical ingredients; with a spark of magic, it burns forever and never dims.
say:11:1560310008:1.source_cn: 据说是用稀有的炼金材料制成的，加以魔法就能长燃不灭，不...

say:12:1560310009:1.text: During the war, we used this oil to light fireworks that scared off Hypofiends. It could light up the whole night sky.
say:12:1560310009:1.source_cn: 在战争时期，我与士兵们曾用这灯油点燃烟花威吓魔物，能把...

say:13:1560310010:1.text: Years have passed, and there's only one bottle left. But it's enough for a lantern.
say:13:1560310010:1.source_cn: 多年过去，只剩下一瓶了。不过，做一盏灯应该足够了。

say:14:1560310011:1.text: Fireworks! That's exactly what we were looking—
say:14:1560310011:1.source_cn: 烟花！这不就是我们要找的——

say:16:1560310013:1.text: Fireworks are supposed to be the highlight of the event. You're counting on them to bring the celebration to its peak. Without them, the whole occasion will feel incomplete.
say:16:1560310013:1.source_cn: 烟花，这原本是计划中最重要的一环。你们一直期待着它将活...
say:16:1560310013:1.male: Fireworks are supposed to be the highlight of the event. You're counting on them to bring the celebration to its peak. Without them, the whole occasion will feel incomplete.
say:16:1560310013:1.female: Fireworks are supposed to be the highlight of the event. You're counting on them to bring the celebration to its peak. Without them, the whole occasion will feel incomplete.

say:17:1560310014:1.text: But there's only one bottle of oil. The moment those fireworks light up the sky is amazing, sure...
say:17:1560310014:1.source_cn: 但灯油只有一瓶。烟花燃烧升空的瞬间，留下的记忆固然美好……

choice_prompt:18:1560310014.text: But there's only one bottle of oil. The moment those fireworks light up the sky is amazing, sure...
choice_prompt:18:1560310014.source_cn: 但灯油只有一瓶。烟花燃烧升空的瞬间，留下的记忆固然美好……

say:20:1560310016:1.text: Sorry, what are you two whispering about?

say:21:1560310017:1.text: N-nothing! Let's get the materials back to the inn and have Zanie help put it all together!
say:21:1560310017:1.source_cn: 没、没什么！我们快把材料送回旅馆，让祖娅帮忙组装起来吧！

narration:22:1560310018:1.text: After receiving the materials, Zanie quickly gets to work. Before long, the hawk moth lantern is ready.
narration:22:1560310018:1.source_cn: 收到材料后，祖娅娴熟地开始了工作。一段时间后，鹰蛾灯制作完成

narration:23:1560310019:1.text: Valka thanks you over and over, then leaves with the lantern...
narration:23:1560310019:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡再三道谢，带着灯告别离去……

say:25:1560310020:0.text: Even if we couldn't find the fireworks materials, just imagining Daimon's face makes me happy.
say:25:1560310020:0.source_cn: 虽然没有找到烟花的材料，但想到戴蒙收到礼物的表情，感觉...

say:27:1560310021:0.text: It's been a long day, Magister! The celebration starts tomorrow. Get some rest tonight!
say:27:1560310021:0.source_cn: 主人辛苦啦！明天就要正式举办庆典了，今天就早点休息吧！
say:27:1560310021:0.male: It's been a long day, Magister! The celebration starts tomorrow. Get some rest tonight!
say:27:1560310021:0.female: It's been a long day, Magister! The celebration starts tomorrow. Get some rest tonight!

choice:18:0:1.text: But what really makes Daimon happy...
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 但能为戴蒙带来快乐的……
choice:18:0:1.male: But what really makes Daimon happy...
choice:18:0:1.female: But what really makes Daimon happy...

choice:18:1:2.text: What keeps a child's hope glowing...
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 让孩子的热情长燃不灭的……
choice:18:1:2.male: What keeps a child's hope glowing...
choice:18:1:2.female: What keeps a child's hope glowing...

choice:18:2:3.source_cn: 戴蒙的隆冬节礼物更重要
